title: Sakey a Melag a Pasakbay Sakbay na Manmartsa a Manag-asikaso
intro: Onloob ka ed sakey a lawak ya walay onaasingger a makapanyarin manuley tan dakel a sundalo, tan imadyin mo so sakey a melag a managbiahe a mangiiter na pasakbay a mangisalba ed interon komunidad. No onsabi so komunidad ya napepeligro ed panagsalimbengan, onlabas so peligro. Tumboken iray pakapatnagan pian naamtaan no antoy ag-anengneng ya pigura ed benegan na satan a pasakbay.
clues: Kaiba ak ed saray angkekelag a pinalsa ya nisiglaot ed panarian na sakey a manuley.
Say komunidad mi et manaayam ed saray ayaman ed loob na lawak, ya ditan et nayarin ontawag so sakey ed sikami ed arum.
Nipapaarap itayo ed panamasegsegang manlapud satan a manuley tan saray sundalo a manbiabiahe a kaiba na manuley.
Siak so ontatawag ed komunidad ko ya onloob ed saray ayaman da tan mamapasakbay ed sikatayo ya ag tayo naderal ya agtayo amta.
Say manuley et si Sulayman, tan say klase ko et kaiba ed saray pinalsa ya inyan ed silong na ganggan to.
Siak so ant na satan a lawak; kayari na pasakbay ko, linmoob kami ed saray ayaman mi tan akaliktar kami ed inkaderal ya ag mi komon amta.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
